menu:506000122:1.text: Let's start getting rid of those nasty rats!
menu:506000122:1.source_cn: 我们现在就开始驱赶这些可恶的老鼠吧！

say:1:1223618001:1.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Rats! The warehouse is infested with rats!
say:1:1223618001:1.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Rats! The warehouse is infested with rats!
say:1:1223618001:1.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Rats! The warehouse is infested with rats!

say:2:1223618002:1.text: We keep all our fish there. If we let those rats feast on them, all our hard work from the past few months will go down the drain!
say:2:1223618002:1.source_cn: 打来的鱼都放在那里，要是便宜了这帮老鼠，大伙儿这几个月...
say:2:1223618002:1.male: We keep all our fish there. If we let those rats feast on them, all our hard work from the past few months will go down the drain!
say:2:1223618002:1.female: We keep all our fish there. If we let those rats feast on them, all our hard work from the past few months will go down the drain!

say:3:1223618003:1.text: Could you help me get rid of the rats? I'd really appreciate it!
say:3:1223618003:1.source_cn: 能去帮我们赶走老鼠吗？拜托了！
say:3:1223618003:1.male: Could you help me get rid of the rats? I'd really appreciate it!
say:3:1223618003:1.female: Could you help me get rid of the rats? I'd really appreciate it!

say:0:1223619001:0.text: This should be the warehouse Al mentioned...
say:0:1223619001:0.source_cn: 阿尔说的仓库，就是这里了吧……
say:0:1223619001:0.male: This should be the warehouse Al mentioned...
say:0:1223619001:0.female: This should be the warehouse Al mentioned...

say:0:1223620001:0.text: Magister, Niko from the Water Wights is there. Let's get more details from him.
say:0:1223620001:0.source_cn: 主人，那是水鬼帮的奈克，问问他怎么回事。
say:0:1223620001:0.male: Magister, Niko from the Water Wights is there. Let's get more details from him.
say:0:1223620001:0.female: Magister, Niko from the Water Wights is there. Let's get more details from him.

say:1:1223621001:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Al told me you'd be coming, but I didn't expect you to get here so soon.
say:1:1223621001:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Al told me you'd be coming, but I didn't expect you to get here so soon.
say:1:1223621001:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Al told me you'd be coming, but I didn't expect you to get here so soon.

say:2:1223621002:0.text: I've placed a trap at the entrance. Let's herd the rats over there together.
say:2:1223621002:0.source_cn: 我把抓鼠陷阱布置在仓库门口，一起把老鼠们赶到那里吧。
say:2:1223621002:0.male: I've placed a trap at the entrance. Let's herd the rats over there together.
say:2:1223621002:0.female: I've placed a trap at the entrance. Let's herd the rats over there together.

say:1:1223622001:1.text: Phew... The rats are finally gone! I'm drenched in sweat.
say:1:1223622001:1.source_cn: 呼……我汗都湿透衣服了，总算赶走这些老鼠了。
say:1:1223622001:1.male: Phew... The rats are finally gone! I'm drenched in sweat.
say:1:1223622001:1.female: Phew... The rats are finally gone! I'm drenched in sweat.

say:2:1223622002:0.text: Next, we need to check the stock... Holy moly! Only bones are left!
say:2:1223622002:0.source_cn: 然后，就是要检查一下库存的鱼……他妈的！怎么被啃成这样了？
say:2:1223622002:0.male: Next, we need to check the stock... Holy moly! Only bones are left!
say:2:1223622002:0.female: Next, we need to check the stock... Holy moly! Only bones are left!

say:3:1223622003:1.text:
Oh, no... These fish were all reserved...
Could you please help me catch some <style="stress">grass carp</style>?
say:3:1223622003:1.source_cn: 糟了，这些都是被预定好的货…………\n能麻烦您帮忙钓些...
say:3:1223622003:1.male:
Oh, no... These fish were all reserved...
Could you please help me catch some <style="stress">grass carp</style>?
say:3:1223622003:1.female:
Oh, no... These fish were all reserved...
Could you please help me catch some <style="stress">grass carp</style>?

say:0:1223624001:0.text: Wow! A huge one just swam by!
say:0:1223624001:0.source_cn: 哇！那游过一条好大的苔鲤！
say:0:1223624001:0.male: Wow! A huge one just swam by!
say:0:1223624001:0.female: Wow! A huge one just swam by!

say:0:1223625001:0.text: Magister, you're getting better at this!
say:0:1223625001:0.source_cn: 主人钓鱼的速度越来越快了！
say:0:1223625001:0.male: Magister, you're getting better at this!
say:0:1223625001:0.female: Magister, you're getting better at this!

say:1:1223626001:1.text: Your fish are of good sizes! We'd be at a loss without your help.
say:1:1223626001:1.source_cn: 您带的鱼都很压秤！要不是有您帮忙，兄弟们都不知道该怎么办了。
say:1:1223626001:1.male: Your fish are of good sizes! We'd be at a loss without your help.
say:1:1223626001:1.female: Your fish are of good sizes! We'd be at a loss without your help.

say:2:1223626002:1.text: That makes you our lifesaver! Don't worry, I'll get the warehouse regularly checked after this.
say:2:1223626002:1.source_cn: 我们都很感谢您，您放心，这之后我会安排兄弟们好好排查仓...
say:2:1223626002:1.male: That makes you our lifesaver! Don't worry, I'll get the warehouse regularly checked after this.
say:2:1223626002:1.female: That makes you our lifesaver! Don't worry, I'll get the warehouse regularly checked after this.
